changes.balance: The premium leaks on intact flows but the floor stays firm without a diplomatic breakthrough. The measurable bid is the BSEE number, not the headlines.
changes.body: Thursday's session was the storm bid: WTI Nov26 closed near $91.49 (+$3.21, +3.6%), Brent Dec26 near $104.28 (+$4.08, +4.1%) (implied from the live tape vs Wednesday's $88.28/$100.20 settles). Hurricane Isaias strengthened to 90 kt overnight (NHC ~06:00 UTC Oct 9) with a Mobile-area landfall early Oct 10, ~36 hours out. BSEE Thursday: 1,282,879 b/d of Gulf oil shut in (62.89%), up from 511,619 b/d (25.08%) Wednesday; 121 platforms evacuated. Overnight into the Singapore morning the tape gave back about a dollar on track uncertainty: WTI ~$90.63 (-$0.86), Brent ~$103.11 (-$1.17), Brent-WTI near $12.50. Curve shape: steep backwardation on both legs (Brent Dec-Jan -$3.32) - tight now, glut later. Houthi strikes killed 3 at Saudi airports this week; a tanker north of Qatar took multiple projectiles Wednesday with casualties (UKMTO via Reuters) - the first casualty-bearing ship hit this round.
changes.conditional: Casualty-bearing strike on Saudi energy infrastructure -> premium rebuilds fast; ceasefire proposal advances -> premium bleeds; Isaias hits refining centers -> distillate premium spikes.
changes.delta: WTI ~+$3.21 Thursday to ~$91.49; Brent ~+$4.08 to ~$104.28; overnight give-back ~$1; Isaias 90 kt, Mobile landfall early Oct 10; BSEE shut-ins 1,282,879 b/d (62.89%)
changes.source: NHC advisory ~06:00 UTC, Oct 9, 2026; BSEE, Oct 8, 2026; oilprice.com live tape, Oct 9, 2026; Yonhap Infomax, Oct 8, 2026; UKMTO via Reuters, Oct 7-8, 2026
changes.title: Storm-bid Thursday; overnight give-back on track uncertainty; Isaias 90 kt ~36h from Mobile landfall

changes.balance: The release is the ceiling on the product market; the physical drivers (Russia's diesel export ban through Oct 31, hurricane track) are the floor. A Gulf Coast refining track on Isaias tightens the distillate leg hard.
changes.body: NYMEX diesel crack overnight session print runs ~$111.60 (Yahoo front-month bar ~02:00 MDT - provisional, not a close), up from Wednesday's $105.87 close. Validated against the refreshed crack history: fifth day of the current $100+ streak (33 total days above $100; first sustained cross 2026-08-17); all-time max $117.92 (Sep 16) - not a record; first $100+ cross 2022-04-28. 3-2-1 at ~$68.50 vs $75.31 max (Aug 28). Heating oil futures (HOY): Nov26 $91.86 (+$2.01) Thursday, Dec26 $91.56 (+$3.11). The IEA is now prioritizing diesel in the accelerated strategic release - a policy admission that distillate is the binding constraint. A Mobile/Pascagoula-area track hits both Gulf production (62.89% shut in) and refining country.
changes.conditional: Isaias tracks into Gulf Coast refining -> distillate tightens hard; front-loaded diesel arrives on schedule -> cracks stay soft into winter.
changes.delta: Diesel crack ~$111.60 overnight print (provisional); Wednesday close $105.87; fifth day of current $100+ streak
changes.source: Validated crack history (Yahoo front-month futures), refreshed Oct 9, 2026; Reuters via lapost.com, Oct 7, 2026
changes.title: Diesel crack ~$111.60 overnight; $100 regime firming, not a record

changes.balance: September's >$20 WCS blowout (widest since Dec 2023) was a refinery-outage event, not an egress event - and it is unwinding on restarts. The December seasonal wide is pricing; the Nov-Dec egress crunch trades on the ~Oct 19 apportionment notice.

ARV Nov26 -$15.93 (-$0.24), Dec26 -$16.25 (+$0.15). ARV-TMW November spread +$8.77/bbl (implied Hardisty-to-Houston export arb, narrowed 16c from +$8.93 but still healthy). changes.balance: Escalation moved from claims to casualties on Saudi soil; barrels still flowing; diplomacy stalled.
changes.body: Yemen/Saudi (Oct 7-8): Houthi strikes killed 1 and wounded 8 at Riyadh's King Khalid airport and killed 2 and wounded 28 at Abha airport (Saudi civil aviation authorities via BusinessWorld Online, Oct 8). Houthis fired two ballistic missiles plus drones at Aden airport early Wednesday. The Saudi-led coalition struck 80+ Houthi military sites across Saada, Hodeidah, Jawf, and Marib late Wednesday. Monday's Yemeni government claim to have retaken Mocha was premature (military officials via thenews.pk, Oct 8). Hormuz (Oct 7-8): tanker north of Qatar struck by multiple projectiles Wednesday with casualties reported (UKMTO via Reuters) - the first casualty-bearing ship hit this round; 12+ incidents Sep 28-Oct 5, the highest weekly rate since the war began. OPEC+ (Oct 4): November quotas held unchanged at 31.01 Mb/d combined (OilPrice, Oct 5); August actual output ~25 Mb/d, ~5 Mb/d below quota. Next review Nov 1; ministerial Nov 29 sets 2027 policy.
changes.conditional: Confirmed strike on Saudi energy infrastructure -> premium rebuilds; Bab el-Mandeb closure -> the event the market cannot price.
changes.delta: 3 killed at Saudi airports (Riyadh 1+8 wounded, Abha 2+28 wounded); Aden airport ballistic attack; 80+ coalition strikes; Qatar tanker strike with casualties; OPEC+ Nov quotas unchanged
changes.source: Reuters/BusinessWorld Online, Oct 7-8, 2026; UKMTO via Reuters, Oct 7-8, 2026; OilPrice, Oct 5, 2026
changes.title: Saudi airport strikes kill 3; coalition retaliates; Hormuz ship hit with casualties

changes.balance: The exchange award is the next real data point for Gulf sour pricing; the Merey-vs-WCS-vs-Mars triangle at the Gulf is the comp-barrel trade against WCS length.
changes.body: The SPR exchange award is still pending - bids went in Tuesday (11:00 a.m. CT deadline), 40 Mbbl of sour (20 Bryan Mound, 20 Big Hill), Nov-Dec delivery, replacement interest 7.5%/9.5% vs June's 18%. No DOE announcement surfaced as of ~02:10 MDT (sixth exchange solicitation under the 172 Mbbl IEA coordinated release; energy-pedia.com, Sep 30). Sparta Commodities (Sep 30) expects Gulf Coast medium grades under pressure through year-end and is watching December Mars FOB below $1/bbl.
changes.conditional: Clean award -> 40 Mbbl of medium sour priced into the Gulf; no-bid -> the cover-shorts trigger.
changes.delta: SPR 40 Mbbl exchange award still pending (bids due Oct 7); no DOE announcement
changes.title: SPR exchange award pending; Gulf sour pricing awaits
